description: Defines the SocketPosix class providing asynchronous socket operations on POSIX systems, including methods for opening, connecting, accepting, reading, writing, and managing socket addresses.

classes.name: SocketPosix
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous socket operations on POSIX systems, supporting AF_INET, AF_INET6, and AF_UNIX addresses.

methods.name: SocketPosix
methods.description: Constructor for SocketPosix.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Takes ownership of an already connected socket.

methods.name: AdoptUnconnectedSocket
methods.description: Takes ownership of a socket that may or may not be connected.

methods.name: ReleaseConnectedSocket
methods.description: Releases ownership of the connected socket.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specified address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Puts the socket into listening mode.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read operation.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Performs a non-blocking read if data is available.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels a pending ReadIfReady operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write operation.

methods.name: WaitForWrite
methods.description: Waits for the socket to be ready for writing.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address of the socket.

methods.name: SetPeerAddress
methods.description: Sets the peer address.

methods.name: HasPeerAddress
methods.description: Checks if the peer address has been set.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches the socket from the current thread.
